kvp_enabled.description: Enable the Hyper-V Key-Value Pair (KVP) daemon for exchanging data between guest and host.

shutdown_enabled.description: Enable the Hyper-V shutdown daemon to handle graceful guest shutdown requests from the host.

time_sync_enabled.description: Enable the Hyper-V time synchronization daemon to keep guest system time in sync with the host.

heartbeat_enabled.description: Enable the Hyper-V heartbeat daemon to report guest health status to the host.

fcopy_enabled.description: Enable the Hyper-V file copy daemon to allow file transfers from host to guest (requires Hyper-V Integration Services).

kvp_bin.description: Override path to the KVP daemon binary. Leave empty to use system default (/usr/sbin/hv_kvp_daemon).

shutdown_bin.description: Override path to the shutdown daemon binary. Leave empty to use system default (/usr/sbin/hv_shutdown).

time_sync_bin.description: Override path to the time sync daemon binary. Leave empty to use system default (/usr/sbin/hv_timesync_daemon).

heartbeat_bin.description: Override path to the heartbeat daemon binary. Leave empty to use system default (/usr/sbin/hv_vss_daemon).

fcopy_bin.description: Override path to the file copy daemon binary. Leave empty to use system default (/usr/sbin/hv_fcopy_daemon).

kvp_extra_args.description: List of extra command-line arguments for the KVP daemon (e.g., ['-v', '--timeout', '30']).

shutdown_extra_args.description: List of extra command-line arguments for the shutdown daemon.

time_sync_extra_args.description: List of extra command-line arguments for the time sync daemon.

heartbeat_extra_args.description: List of extra command-line arguments for the heartbeat daemon.

fcopy_extra_args.description: List of extra command-line arguments for the file copy daemon.

env_vars.description: Custom environment variables to export before launching daemons (e.g., ['HYPERV_LOG_DIR=/var/log/hyperv']). Each item must be a 'KEY=value' pair.
